subject.target_stable_key: Target stable key of a touched subject, or entity_locator for a touched entity subject

facts.value: Complete claim for write, except inferred_name: only one preferred direct name (for example ftLk_SpecialN_RemoveArrow), following inferred_name_contract; no prose, wrapping quotes/backticks, signatures, or alternatives. Empty string for clear.
facts.rationale: Argument connecting the cited evidence to this value or clear operation. For inferred_name, put explanations, uncertainty, and alternative candidates here; value holds only the preferred name.

evidence.locator: Closed-grammar locator: pr://<pr-id>/comment/<i>, discord://message/<id>, wiki://<page~section@rev>, attempt://run/<run-id>/submission/<n>, or code://<head_revision>/<tracked path>#L<start>-L<end>.
evidence.why: What this specific source record shows.

from.target_stable_key: Touched target stable key, or entity_locator of a touched entity

to.entity_locator: Entity locator (game concept, pattern, struct, struct field); never a target

entities.note: Why this curated entity is needed for a supported fact, citing the wiki or discussion record that names the mechanic.

merges.why: Evidence that both locators identify the same entity.

subject.target_stable_key: Stable key of a subject outside the writable scope, or entity_locator

follow_ups.why: What this pass learned about the subject that a later pass, with the subject in scope, should act on.
